review_pass_1.type: separate internal scientific and syllabus review
checks: Matched official Unit 5.C and approved chapter scope; did not duplicate full maternal-axis or signaling chapters.

Checked classical mutant classes, enhancer regulatory logic, gap network, Odd-paired timing, Wg/Hh local maintenance, offset parasegments, Hox/homeobox distinction and Ubx transformations against selected textbook, primary and review sources.
Recomputed 90/190/175 µm windows, 8.39036 min threshold crossing, independent occupancy, affinity thresholds, normalized positions and percentage changes.
Labeled hypothetical values and simplified models; avoided claiming a universal ATP-per-segment relationship.
review_pass_1.limitations: Selected accessible source text and abstracts, not full independent peer review. Current MPPSC-hosted syllabus copy not verified.

review_pass_2.type: separate internal teaching and examination review
checks: Reordered 25 sections into causal progression; compared 5.A.07 exemplar (13,192 words, 128 marked teaching paragraphs).
Checked 52 answer keys against options and explanations, 17 misconceptions, 12 active recalls, original figures, source links and numerical examples.
Verified unique IDs, internal anchors, ARIA labels, diagram controls and JavaScript parsing; improved dark-theme diagram contrast.
review_pass_2.limitations: Static HTML and script checks only; no interactive rendering, external item calibration or human peer review.
